verdict.rationale: Slack is a SaaS collaboration product with built-in AI features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an opt-out or any policy preventing customer data from being used for model training. Admin approval of MCP client integrations (slack-docs-46) is an adjacent access control, not a training-data control, so it earns no credit.
